text: A dark theme. Switch it with the moon button in the header and the site remembers your choice.
Submit Event is now in the header on every page, and you don't need the organiser's permission to send one in.
This changelog.
A festival listed both as a whole and day by day no longer shows up as separate sessions.
Courses and festivals show on every day they run, and events on specific dates show only on those dates.
Month view on the home page: pick a day to see what's on.
Google Developer Groups: GDG Dehradun, UPES and Graphic Era.
Grey text is darker and easier to read.
Twice as many events from AllEvents, now with times and descriptions.
Events show in time order, all-day events stay listed through the day, and the Weekend filter works in any timezone.
Events from outside India no longer slip onto the site.
Ticket prices from AllEvents are read from each event's own page, and the lowest price is shown.
When one source has only a placeholder venue or description, the real one from another source is kept.
Opening an event in a new tab no longer empties the list.
Events found on Reddit show clean descriptions instead of stray code.
Submit an event: anyone can send one in, and every entry is checked by hand.
Events in Maldevta are counted as Dehradun.
Filter counts match the other filters you have picked.
Virasat performances are listed even before their artist is announced.
Shared event links show a preview card, and every event page has a Report a problem link.
Filter by category, area and price, and subscribe to a calendar for one category or source.
BookMyShow becomes an occasional extra source; District stays the main one.
doon.today launches: Dehradun events from District, AllEvents, Virasat, Meetup and local organisers, with calendar subscriptions.
